title: Live Canvas on mobile /ai — split doesn't fit; open full-screen instead
body:
Split out from #2477 item 1 (mobile chat). The mobile full-page bridge sends phone users from the chat sheet to full-page `/ai`, which on mobile already has conversation history + share. The one thing that still degrades on a phone is the **Live Canvas** (ADR-0037): on `/ai` the canvas opens *beside* the chat in a resizable split, and at < `md` there's no room for two columns — the split reads cramped/broken.

This is a pre-existing `/ai` mobile-responsiveness gap (independent of the dock), and rare in practice (few people run a `build` session on a phone), so it was deliberately left out of the mobile bridge.

Proposed when addressed: on mobile, the Live Canvas should open **full-screen over the chat** (canvas-only, a back button returns to chat) rather than the desktop side-by-side split. The desktop split is unchanged. Alternatively, on mobile suppress the beside-chat preview entirely and lean on the existing "Open app" (the published app is responsive).

Refs ADR-0057 (§4 — presentation is per-audience/idiom) · #2477
